sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People First Amendment Ordinance 1979
sections.description:
Substitution of Chapter V, Act LXXXV of 1976

ORDINANCE L OF 1979
ORDINANCE L OF 1979
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An ordinance further to amend the Representation of the People Act,
1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 19th September 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The
following Ordinance made by the President on the 17th September, 1979 is hereby
published for general information:‑
9. Substitution of Chapter V, Act LXXXV of 1976.‑In the said
Act, for Chapter V the following Chapters V and VA shall be substituted,
namely:‑
CHAPTER V.‑ELECTION TO SEATS RESERVED FOR WOMEN
47. Election to Seats Reserved for Women.‑(1) Nothing in
Chapters III and IV shall apply to an election to fill a seat reserved in an
Assembly for women.
(2) The members for seats
reserved for women in the National Assembly which are allocated to a Province
shall be elected, subject to the provisiors of clause (4) of Article 4 to the
Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 [P. (P.
P.) O. No. 5 of 1977], on the bass of the system of proportional representation
by means of a single transferable vote by the electoral college consisting of
the persons elected from that Province.
(3) The members for seats
reserved for women in a Provincial Assembly shall be elected, subject to the
provisions of clause (4) of Article 6 of thro Houses of Parliament and
Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 LF. (P. P.) Order No. 5 of 1977],
on the basis of the system of proportional representation by means of a single
transferable vote by the electoral college consisting of the persons elected to
that Assembly.
(4) The Commission shall hold and
conduct the election to fill the seats reserved in an Assembly for women in
such manner as may be prescribed.
CHAPTER VA‑ELECTION TO SEATS RESERVED FOR NON‑MUSLIMS
47‑A. Election to Seats Reserved for Non‑Muslims.‑(1)
The members for seats reserved for persons belonging to the Christian, Hindu,
Sikh, Buddhiot and Parsi Communities and persons of the Qadiani Group or the
Lahori Group (who call themselves `Ahmadis') and other non‑Muslims and
persons belonging to the Scheduled Castes, hereinafter referred to as the non‑Muslim
seats, shall be elected, through a direct and free vote, by electors who are
enrolled on the electoral rolls for non‑Muslims so that each elector has
only one non‑transferable vote for a constituency of the National
Assembly or, as the case may be, for a constituency of a Provincial Assembly.
(2) For the purpose of election
to a non‑Muslim seat in the National Assembly or in a Provincial Assembly,
each Province shall constitute a constituency with as many seats as there are
non‑Muslim seats in the National Assembly allocated to that Province, or
as the case may be, with as many seats as there are non‑Muslim seats in
the Provincial Assembly for that province.
(3) The Commission shall hold and
conduct the election to fill the non-Muslim seats in an Assembly in such manner
as may be prescribed.
(4) The provisions of this Act,
except those of sections 18, 20, 21 and 39 to 43 of Chapter IV, shall apply to
the election to the non‑Muslim seats in an Assembly."

following Ordinance made by the President on the 17th September, 1979 is hereby

10. Amendment of section 49 Act LXXXV of 1976.‑In the said
Act, in section 49, in subsection (3), for the full‑stop at the end a
colon shall be substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall be added,
namely:
"Provided that the election

fifty thousand rupees in the case of a Provincial Assembly."
